blockingFindings.title: Draft review PASS artifacts are omitted
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R3/R4/T-4 review lifecycle
**Issue:** Existing registry review post behavior writes empty draft triage and repair JSON artifacts on draft PASS before marking the triage and repair steps done. src/flow/lib/run-gate.js then validates those artifacts and reports missing draft triage/repair artifacts when they are absent. The spec covers review status transitions but does not require preserving this mandatory artifact data path through a lifecycle hook action or handler call.
**Required change:** Add the smallest review-lifecycle requirement and acceptance basis that draft PASS routes must generate or invoke the existing handler to generate the empty draft triage/repair artifacts before downstream draft gate validation.
**Why blocking:** An implementation can satisfy status-transition checks while omitting the artifacts, leaving draft-gate unable to pass after a PASS draft review because required draft triage/repair files are missing.

blockingFindings.title: Impl review proposal reset side effects are omitted
blockingFindings.body:
**Target:** R3/R4/T-4 review lifecycle
**Issue:** Existing review post behavior calls resetImplEvidenceAfterReviewProposals when implementation review produces proposals. That path removes rebuildable test artifacts and resets downstream leaves from test-execute through finalize-cleanup to pending while keeping impl-review from being marked done. The spec mentions keep-in-progress and downstream reset behavior, but does not identify this review-specific data path or make it observable in acceptance/tests.
**Required change:** Add the implementation-review lifecycle case that proposal-producing impl reviews must run the existing evidence-reset hook or equivalent and reset the definition-derived downstream range from test-execute through finalize-cleanup.
**Why blocking:** Without this, stale test, retro, and finalize evidence can remain marked valid after review-applied code changes, allowing later flow steps to proceed against invalid artifacts even though status-only lifecycle tests pass.
